description: Use this to run an ENTIRE hackathon campaign hands-off in ONE session — intake the user's constraints (which steps, demo video, submission, budget: $0 or funds-allowed), lock them as a committed campaign contract, then dispatch and verify every pipeline step (0a extract → 0 idea-forge → 1 architect → 2 build → 2.5 demo video → 3 gates + submission) autonomously, with every consent pre-collected and identity-bound up front. Trigger it when the user says "build the full project autonomously", "run the whole pipeline hands-off", "autopilot this hackathon", "take <event> end to end", or pastes prompts/INVOKE_AUTOPILOT.md. The only mid-run interactions are hard stops (floor items, identity mismatches, capability gaps). Do NOT use it when the user wants approval touchpoints between steps — that's the guide (interactive mode, the default for a first campaign) — and never self-trigger it: full autonomy is always the user's explicit ask.
